title: Register of cipher telegrams to the Seraskerlik and the army commands (Arkeoloji 01660), with the Fourth Army cipher key (Arkeoloji 01652)
correspondents: Seraskerlik (War Ministry) and Ottoman army commands; Fourth Army (Erzurum, Van)
shelfmark: Istanbul Archaeological Museums, Arkeoloji Yazmalari 01660 (YEK 708872, 112 ff., 115 images) and 01652 (YEK 708867, 35 ff., 91 images)
folio_note: 01652: 35 ff., images 5-38 written: image 6 (f. 5b) a letter table with 2-3 two-digit homophones per letter, images 7-34 a vocabulary of words and names with three-digit numbers (427-899 seen), image 36 the letter table again in pencil. 01660: 112 ff., one clear Ottoman telegram per leaf (recto), versos blank, cover reads 'sifreli telgrafnameler 1305, 1306'
score_note: Screened on the images, 26 Nov 2026 (signed in). 01652 is a real cipher key (homophonic letter table plus a three-digit word code), 01660 holds the DECODED telegram copies only: no figures in 8 of 115 sampled images (3, 20, 40, 55, 70, 85, 100, 115). A key without ciphertext, so no plaintext/ciphertext pair.
status: Screened: key (01652) seen, telegrams (01660) in clear. Not a lead for the catalogue (no ciphertext); worth a transcription of the key as a late-Ottoman nomenclator and a note to the Ottoman-cryptography literature.
why: A nomenclator key of the Fourth Army (Erzurum, Van) with its decoded telegram register: useful as a documented late-Ottoman system, not as unsolved ciphertext.
verify: Done 26 Nov 2026; remaining only to read all 100 or so telegram leaves for any in figures (8 of 115 images sampled).
prior_art: Ottoman diplomatic cryptography 1811-1877 (Bingol, Cryptologia 2023) and 19th-century special-purpose ciphers (Karabacak Yilmaz, TTK) found by web search, titles only; no record of 01652/01660 in research/catalogue_harvest/decode or the 24 Nov notes. Not checked: Bingol's text.
